source: faça um jogo ultra realista com várias florestas e vegetações em 3D de um jogo de animais com vários animais que dá para controlar e os animais em 3D com o mapa gigantesco com vários Rios no mapa e a movimentação de andar correr dos animais ultra realista com botão joystick correr bater pular e o jogo com a textura ultra realista na vida real

image_prompt.text: Natural shelters - caves, hollows, burrows among the tree roots - that the animal players claim and return to
Distinct natural structures visible across the huge map so players can navigate the forest by sight
An oversized natural clearing where animals gather without crowding
Several dense forests with thick, lifelike vegetation covering a gigantic map
Several rivers winding through the map, dividing the forests
Controllable animals of several species living throughout the forests and along the water

notes: Prompt is in Portuguese; classification and options were read from it directly.
The user asks for ultra-realistic textures and animation, which is a rendering and animation demand the layout pipeline cannot honour by itself.

open_questions.ask: How big is gigantic - a few square kilometres of forest, or something a player could cross in a couple of minutes?
What do the animals do - survive, hunt each other, roleplay a pack?

theme: Ultra-realistic - photoreal forest vegetation and real-life textures, as stated by the user

coverage_missing.ask: Is there a survival loop - hunting, hunger, packs - or is it free roaming as an animal?
How large should the map actually be?
Which real-world region should the forests read as - temperate, jungle, boreal?

answers.ask: How big is gigantic - a few square kilometres of forest, or something a player could cross in a couple of minutes?
answers.answer: Quero um mapa grande, mas que o jogador consiga atravessar em alguns minutos, com várias áreas de floresta, vegetação e rios para manter o jogo leve e jogável.

answers.ask: What do the animals do - survive, hunt each other, roleplay a pack?
answers.answer: O foco é sobrevivência na natureza, com os animais podendo explorar o mapa e atacar outros animais quando necessário.
